name: t9_tde_trigger_criterion
description: Micro-TDE trigger criterion (Rastello et al. 2026): BH 20.059 Msun (kw=14) + MS star 2.3934 Msun (Z=0.02, BSE ZAMS R=1.7543 Rsun, r_t=3.563 Rsun) on engineered two-body orbits; a 0.5 Msun bystander at 1 pc keeps the tree/hard channel populated. Bound grid (a=100 AU, marked binary, start at apocentre) and hyperbolic grid (v_inf=5 km/s, start 100 AU inbound) sweep the pericentre through beta=0.3..5; NS (1.4 Msun, kw=13) checks the second compact-object branch; MS-MS control has no CO. Detection boundary must sit at beta=1: exactly one event for beta>=1.1, none for beta<=0.9; events route by orbit sign to data .bse.hyperbolic_tde / .binary_tde; the disrupted star becomes a kw=15 massless remnant and the CO accretes ftzacc=0.1 of the stellar mass (mix.f).
